questions.stem: What type of wave is sound?
questions.explanation: Sound is a longitudinal wave. The particles of the medium vibrate back and forth parallel to the direction the sound travels, creating compressions (particles close together) and rarefactions (particles spread apart).

questions.stem: What is the approximate range of human hearing?
questions.explanation: The typical range of human hearing is 20 Hz to 20,000 Hz (20 kHz). Sounds below 20 Hz are called infrasound, and sounds above 20 kHz are called ultrasound.
